modelName: KSLAS Prohibited Object Detector - EfficientDet Lite0 COCO

policy.note: The installed baseline is COCO-trained. Phone is high risk; books, bags, laptop/keyboard/mouse/remote/tv and similar visible materials are routed to manual review with evidence. A custom KSLAS dataset is still required for calculator, paper-note, and earphone accuracy.

fallback.reason: Keep local detection available when the production TFLite model is missing or fails.
